create.name: Sarah Powers
create.bio:
Sarah Powers is a yoga and meditation teacher who has taught since the mid-1980s and is known for joining yin yoga with Buddhist mindfulness. Her approach, which she calls Insight Yoga, pairs long-held floor postures aimed at the meridians of Chinese medicine with a slower, mindful flow, and sets both alongside seated meditation and reflective inquiry. Her own practice draws on Vipassana, Tantric and Dzogchen Buddhism, studied through extended retreats, as well as Taoist ideas and training in Psychosynthesis and Internal Family Systems. She wrote Insight Yoga, an early and widely read book on yin practice, and later Lit from Within.

With her husband Ty Powers, a Spirit Rock-trained Vipassana teacher, she founded the Insight Yoga Institute in 2010, which offers a 500-hour teacher pathway built from trainings and retreats. The couple lead residential retreats, many held in social silence, at centres such as Mandali in northern Italy and Kripalu in Massachusetts, and teach workshops in Asia and Europe. Sarah also runs a 30-hour online primary-level training that mixes recorded and live sessions, and several of her recorded classes and short courses can be streamed.

Sarah Powers shares her yoga story with Adam

books.title: Insight Yoga: An Innovative Synthesis of Traditional Yoga, Meditation, and Eastern Approaches to Healing and Well-Being
books.author: Sarah Powers
books.description: Her first book, published by Shambhala, setting out yin and yang sequences alongside meridian theory from Chinese medicine and Buddhist mindfulness practice. It includes illustrated practice sequences for home use.

books.title: Lit from Within: Yoga, Teachings, and Practices to Illuminate Our Inner Lives
books.author: Sarah Powers
books.description: A later book that treats yoga as a path of self-understanding across five layers of experience, from the body and energy to emotions, thought and relationships. Each part pairs reflection with practices such as yin postures, meditation and inquiry.

courses.title: Yin/Insight Yoga Retreat
courses.description: A weekend retreat at Kripalu in Stockbridge, Massachusetts, led with Ty Powers and held in social silence. Sessions combine meditation, yin and yang yoga, quiet time alone and partner inquiry. At least a year of yoga practice and some familiarity with yin and mindfulness are recommended.

courses.title: Mandali - Italy - Yin/Insight Yoga and Inquiry Silent Retreat with Sarah and Ty Powers (2027)
courses.description: A week-long silent retreat with Ty Powers at Mandali, a hilltop centre above Lake Orta in the Italian Alps foothills. Days include meditation, yin and yang yoga, partner inquiry and individual time with the teachers. Prior silent-retreat experience or steady practice with Sarah and Ty is required.

courses.title: Insight Yoga Primary Level Training Online
courses.description: A 30-hour online training mixing pre-recorded lessons with live group meetings, covering yin and yang yoga, meridian theory, Buddhist teaching and mindfulness meditation. It suits both practitioners and teachers, and completing the final assignment earns a certificate and Yoga Alliance continuing education hours.

courses.title: Insight Yoga with Sarah Powers (Sangha Live)
courses.description: A recorded online course of four modules, each pairing yin postures for one group of meridians with one of the four foundations of mindfulness. It serves as an introduction to Insight Yoga and comes with lifetime access.

courses.title: Insight Yoga: Yin Yoga Intermediate Practice
courses.description: An 84-minute streamed class from Pranamaya combining held yin postures with a flowing sequence and a short Buddhist-style meditation at the end.

free_resources.title: Lit from Within: Sarah Powers on Keen on Yoga (podcast)
free_resources.description: A long podcast conversation with Adam Keen about how Buddhist teaching and yoga practice fit together in her work and in her book Lit from Within. Free to listen.

free_resources.title: Skillful Means Podcast: Sarah Powers on embodying love and compassion
free_resources.description: An interview on carrying self-compassion and curiosity from the mat into daily life, and on staying present with others without taking on their burdens. Free to listen.
